duplicates.notes: One public route per locale. The registry replaces only the exact predecessor with the same public slug.

ingredients.notes: Six weighed rows. The cooking water and syrup water are split explicitly. The intact fresh pandan leaf is taken out before portioning.

method.notes: The recipe follows the published rice-flour porridge and knotted pandan method. The sauce ratio comes from the Indonesian recipe. No physical trial was performed.

food_safety.notes: Bring the rice-flour mixture to a visible simmer and continue cooking before tasting. Cool and refrigerate leftovers promptly.

servings_and_time.notes: Four equal portions of the entire porridge and sauce batch, with 35 minutes estimated and the syrup made while the porridge cooks.

nutrition.notes: Fineli, AFCD and PhilFCT ingredient records were checked and independently recomputed. The public values are withheld because PhilFCT does not report polyols and pandan extract retention is unquantified.

glycemic.notes: Human comparators use different rice preparations or different sugar products. No applicable numeric GK was established for this dish.
